title: Error Budget Runway and Initiative Prioritization Playbook
creator: Alex Chen
description: Goal: Define a repeatable playbook that converts current SLO metrics and error-budget burn into prioritized initiatives for the next three roadmap cycles. This ticket captures the proposal for an 'error budget runway' concept (a time-based view of remaining error budget) and an associated prioritization rubric that PMs/Eng should use when deciding feature rollouts, reliability fixes, and canary sizing. Scope: 1) Spec for 'runway' dashboard widget and API inputs, 2) Prioritization rubric that maps runway bands to recommended actions (delay, reduce rollout %, urgent mitigation), 3) Integration points with cycle planning and OKR intake forms, 4) Owner and communication playbook for cross-functional escalation. Out of scope: detailed UI mocks (handed to Design), low-level runtime changes to SLI collection (handled in ENG tickets). Success metrics: - 100% of reliability-impacting initiatives use the rubric during two consecutive cycles - Reduce unplanned rollbacks due to SLO breaches by 30% in the following quarter - Time-to-decision for high-burn events <= 4 hours from detection
acceptance_criteria: Runway spec doc reviewed and approved by Eng and Observability
Prioritization rubric published in Confluence with examples mapped to past incidents
Roadmap intake form updated to include SLO/runway fields
Dashboard prototype (data + example thresholds) available in staging
Hand-off tickets created for design and engineering work
